item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://www.engineering.com/?p=151329","version_id":"a5a6e64fd4f2a87b5b45be5afd0c01d19fd3ee1e8b8f12be9e7e49964e03d82b","decision":"accept","reason":"This is fresh, dated CAD-and-simulation coverage with a quotable commercial claim: SimScale says its Onshape agent can take CAD geometry, propose a setup, mesh and run physics, and return results in Onshape. It is directly relevant to agentic engineering workflows, but the described check is a vendor-reported product capability rather than an independent assessment of setup quality, solver validity, or manufacturability; those would require disclosed test models, conditions, and expert review. The item also reports Comsol's planned MCP server as a forthcoming interoperability development, not evidence that an AI system produces correct simulation decisions.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
